messages:
olivia: Quick sync — inventory found 47 ownerless admin bindings (console + infra roles). Need a remediation plan for the quarterly access review (SOC/ISO evidence). Proposed: 2-week cleanup window starting Mon 2024-04-08. Thoughts? @raj @kevin :eyes:

raj: +1. Do we have mapping of SSO groups -> role bindings? I can run a join with the SCIM export and IAM bindings and produce owner candidates.

kevin: We should flag any admin principals that also have KMS decrypt/cryptoKey access. Removing admin could break workloads. I'll run an access matrix.

olivia: Agreed. Priority: (1) owner assignment, (2) exceptions w/ documented justification, (3) staged role removal + monitor. We'll need audit evidence for each change.

audit-bot: Inventory run complete: 47 ownerless admin bindings. CSV: https://redwood.internal/artifacts/ownerless_admins_2024-04-01.csv. Report ID: RBAC-INV-20240401

raj: Plan for automation: I can submit a PR that creates RFC-style change objects in our infra repo. Workflow: detect -> create change file -> open PR -> assign owner -> 48h approval -> merge -> orchestrated removal with canary 10%.

kevin: KMS check example:
```
# list principals with key access
gcloud kms keys list --location=global --project=redwood-prod --format="json" | jq '.[] | select(.bindings[].role=="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter")'
```
Will output principals to cross-check.

jen: legal note: retain justification docs for 7 years per policy and attach to change record. Also we need an exceptions spreadsheet with sign-off.

olivia: Who can own owner assignment? @raj will generate owner candidates. Volunteers for validation: @kevin @maria

maria: I'll take validation for infra team principals. :thumbsup:

olivia: Cool. Next steps: raj to push candidate list by EOD Thu. kevin to provide KMS risk list. We'll do canary removals next Tue for a subset and monitor error rates. If failure > 0.5% revert. I'll open the change window calendar invite. Thanks team.
